methods.label: Eliminate both variables
methods.explanation:
The second equation's left side is exactly twice the first equation's left side. Therefore, any solution of the first equation must satisfy
\[
4x-6y=2(7)=14.
\]
But the second equation requires the same expression to equal \(20\). Subtracting these requirements gives the impossible equality \(0=6\). Thus no pair \((x,y)\) satisfies both equations, so the answer is \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
